answer: A marble audit at epoch end draws one identity at random from each grove cluster and replays its proof against the registry. When the replay ties it to a second identity of the same operator, a ripple fine of 450,000 POA per fake spreads across that operator's whole cluster, paid from its bond to honest peers, and every identity in the cluster loses its full reward of about 258,000 POA. Five fakes therefore cost about 3,540,000 POA — 2,250,000 POA in fines plus 1,290,000 POA in lost rewards — before any of the operator's identities can earn again.
